blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente “Tito” Sotto III has filed a resolution seeking to establish clear guidelines for addressing senators’ prolonged unauthorized absences. Sotto said such absenteeism and neglect of duty “are deemed a waste of taxpayer funds and have caused public clamor over the past months.” In Senate Resolution No. 751, […]...
